meta.name: Spartacus House of Ashur
meta.description: In a world where he survived the events of Spartacus, Ashur clawed his way to power, owning the same ludus that once owned him. Allying with a fierce gladiatrix, Ashur ignites a new kind of spectacle that offends the elite.

videos.title: Dominus
videos.overview: Having no memory of his downfall in "Spartacus: Vengeance," Ashur wakes to find himself the owner of the former House of Batiatus; eager to earn the respect and power he's always desired, Ashur must save face by presenting something new to the arena.

videos.title: Forsaken
videos.overview: Ashur navigates the treacherous waters of the Roman elites while Achillia struggles to acclimate to the brutal life of a gladiator in training.

videos.title: Unworthy
videos.overview: Korris faces Ashur's wrath and must prove himself worthy.

videos.title: Blood and Bone
videos.overview: Ashur frantically tries to enter the Ludi Apollinares games before Marcus Crassus arrives.

videos.title: Goddess of Death
videos.overview: Ashur presents Achillia to the public, where she faces her first battle in the arena.

videos.title: Empty Things
videos.overview: Ashur's popularity within Capua soars, but at a devastating cost.

videos.title: Deepest Wound
videos.overview: Korris demands blood; Ashur attempts to sway an enemy toward his cause.

videos.title: Horizons
videos.overview: Achillia prepares for her return to the arena, while Ashur faces a devastating setback.

videos.title: Those Who Remain
videos.overview: Caesar demands a painful sacrifice from Ashur.

videos.title: Hail Caesar
videos.overview: Achillia returns to the arena to face her greatest challenge, while Ashur wrestles with the emotional fallout of his actions.
